title: A flaky test is a broken test

blocks.content: Retries hide flakes and train the team to re-run instead of reading. Most intermittent failures come from a handful of causes worth hunting down properly.

items: Shared mutable state between tests, usually a database row or a module global
Real clocks and real sleeps instead of fake timers
Tests that depend on execution order
Unawaited promises that resolve into the next test

blocks.title: Quarantine, don't retry
blocks.content: Move a flaky test out of the blocking suite and open a ticket. Leaving it in with retries means the pipeline no longer tells you anything.
